method: Source-level logical loop/comparator counts, full occupied1024ledger and no clone routes after warm. Not measured runtime instructions or timing attribution.
cold_changed_ledger: First pass always accounts all blocks/metadata; after first inverse pointer order it stops provisional root charging, then sorts full private ledger and resets/recomputes only root accounting. O(L log L) cold comparison/move cost plus scans; no measured cold latency.
remaining: Distinct roots times clone routes, driver.active costs, preflight_backing existing ledger/incoming scans and retain scans remain.
